summary: Proved the nine-factor denominator is the cube of a symmetric cubic and reduced the generic denominator to C=e3^-+e3^+. Exact pole subtraction leaves a polynomial remainder whose pair-wall jump is linear in q_mp, not cubic. The compact degree-six wall prefactor remains open.

Verified Delta=C^3 on 750 exact BG points and the active-channel reduction on 5079/5079 channels.

Independently implemented the compact nine-channel pole formula and obtained primitive-scaled polynomial remainders on 750/750 exact points.
Interpolated three isolated two-sided q_24 wall crossings; all branch fit and holdout residuals were zero and all jumps had exact multiplicity one.
Scanned 35380 arbitrary-sign exact solutions and observed only the same eight momentum words; the 750 BG set spans 19 energy-sign patterns.
Rechecked the five-point calibration at 3/3 exact points and sector permutations at 6/6 exact points.
Used the reusable technician thread /root/technician for the initial driver patch and the later compact-pole subtraction implementation, then independently audited and corrected both batches.
